'''Lamma Sor''' occurs the day after the first quarter moon{{ref|The quarter moon is also called a "knife moon."}} of the month of [[Saban]]. The solemn holiday is also called the "Day of Remembrance." On this day, nothing is eaten but bread, water, salt, and oil. It is a day of prayers for all those who have and all those who will fall defending against the [[Blight]].

It is celebrated in the [[Borderlands]].{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 31}}
